title: Extracting and Evaluating Activity Distributions in Rat Electrocorticograms
author: Mellbin, Rongala, et al.
materials: Forceps and surgical needle.(B) Instruments used for craniotomy.
Stabilizing ear rods and snout stabilizing ring.
Dental drill.(C) Electrodes and heating pad.

steps.title: Gather preparatory surgery tools
steps.instruction: Collect all instruments shown in Figure 3A, including scalpel, tissue forceps, vein catheter, dissection scissors, surgical fine forceps, vascular scissors, microsurgical forceps (tip size 0.005 × 0.25 mm), catheter tweezers, forceps and surgical needle, and ensure the hair clipper is fully charged.

steps.title: Prepare ketamine‑xylazine mixtures
steps.instruction: Make two separate batches of ketamine/xylazine solution: (a) Batch 1 with a ketamine : xylazine ratio of 15 : 1 for intraperitoneal (IP) injection; (b) Batch 2 with a ratio of 20 : 1 for continuous intravenous (IV) infusion. Clearly label each batch to avoid confusion.

steps.title: Calculate anesthesia doses
steps.instruction: Weigh the rat and compute the required doses: IP injection at 0.0014 mL per gram of body weight; IV infusion at 0.0006 mL per hour per gram of body weight.

steps.title: Induce anesthesia with isoflurane
steps.instruction: Place the rat in a ventilated container, cover with a dark cloth, and start a flow of isoflurane/oxygen mixture at 3 % isoflurane. Wait 1–2 min until the rat is deeply sedated.

steps.title: Administer IP ketamine‑xylazine
steps.instruction: Transfer the rat to the operation table and inject the previously prepared IP ketamine/xylazine mixture. Verify deep anesthesia by confirming the absence of a withdrawal reflex to a noxious pinch on the hind paw.

steps.title: Insert femoral catheter
steps.instruction: Perform the following substeps to place a catheter in the femoral vein (note: the protocol refers to the femoral artery but the steps describe the vein).

substeps.instruction: a. Position the rat on its back and stretch the hind leg.
b. Shave the area above the femoral vein.
c. Make a skin incision above the femoral vein with a scalpel.
d. Remove connective tissue using blunt dissection.
e. Carefully separate the femoral vein from the artery with tweezers.
f. Pull off any remaining connective tissue from the vein using fine forceps (avoid damaging the artery).
g. Place two surgical sutures under the vein, one below and one above the planned insertion site.
h. Tie the lower suture to stop blood flow.
i. Cut a small hole in the vein with vascular scissors (size must allow catheter entry without tearing the vein).
j. Lift the upper edge of the incision with microsurgical forceps (tip 0.005 × 0.25 mm) and insert the catheter past the upper ligature.
k. Aspirate blood to confirm correct catheter placement, then tie the upper ligature tightly around the vein and catheter.
l. Administer a first dose of intravenous anesthesia through the catheter and check for leakage.

steps.title: Complete surgery and start infusion
steps.instruction: Finalize the surgical procedure and begin intravenous anesthesia infusion.

substeps.instruction: a. Place a small piece of cotton soaked in 0.9 % NaCl solution into the wound to keep tissue moist.
b. Close the wound with surgical sutures.
c. Transfer the rat carefully to the stereotaxic frame, attaching the femoral catheter to the infusion apparatus.
d. Start the anesthetic infusion and adjust the rate according to the rat’s body weight (0.0006 mL h⁻¹ g⁻¹).
e. Do NOT pull on the femoral catheter while moving the rat.
f. Continuously monitor anesthesia depth; administer additional IP anesthesia if needed.

steps.title: Gather craniotomy preparation tools
steps.instruction: Collect the instruments shown in Figure 3B (e.g., wound retracting hooks, NaCl, stabilizing ear rods, snout stabilizing ring, blunt scalpel, bone Rongeur forceps, bone wax scalpel, dental drill).

steps.title: Prepare agar‑agar and ancillary materials
steps.instruction: Mix agar‑agar with NaCl solution on a magnetic stirrer placed on a hot plate and heat until dissolved; cut approximately 1 × 3 mm strips of Spongostan; place bone wax on a warm surface to soften; heat paraffin oil in a water bath to 38 °C.

steps.title: Fixate rat’s head in stereotaxic frame
steps.instruction: Secure the rat for craniotomy using the following substeps.

substeps.instruction: a. Apply xylocaine salve to the ends of the stabilizing ear rods and insert them into the external acoustic meatus; fix the rods in the stereotaxic frame (ensure proper insertion to minimize discomfort).
b. Place the snout stabilizing ring on the rat’s upper jaw, making sure the front teeth pass through the ring.
c. Move the tongue to the side to avoid pressure.
d. Shave the fur from the scalp.

steps.title: Exclude corrupted recordings
steps.instruction: Discard any ECoG recordings that show cortical tissue damage, pool leakage, electrode interference, or failed stimulation before proceeding to analysis.

steps.title: Run permutation test for kNN
steps.instruction: Assess the significance of k‑nearest‑neighbors (kNN) decoding accuracy by repeating the kNN classification with shuffled labels to generate a chance‑level accuracy distribution.

steps.title: Analyze kNN group results
steps.instruction: For each stimulation group (e.g., frequency, location), compute the median decoding accuracy across all stimulation periods. Compare groups using the Wilcoxon rank‑sum test.
